items.title: Victor Rendon interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, November 15, 2019 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: I think Candido did some recordings with him.

ctx.x: I think Candido did some recordings with him. So yeah, that’s one way to adapt. I didn’t pay attention to that, I thought it was something important. And a gentleman I think wrote a book about it. He did a lot of research and he called me for my input and I really didn’t have much input to give him because I had never really thought about it but he did like a whole thing with a discography and it’s really interesting. But it’s basically based on that [scats], just swinging those eighth notes. And that’s what I…
You know what happened, they listened to a recording.
